dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular, high-contrast light-colored perimeters forming closed 'O' and semi-closed 'C' geometries; edges exhibit sharp intensity gradients transitioning from high-value borders to low-value centers, most prominent across the mid-dorsal region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of small, solid high-intensity light pixel clusters lacking internal gradients, primarily distributed in the anterior-dorsal neck region and interspersed between larger annular structures.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three largest mid-dorsal macro-annuli form an obtuse scalene triangle; a secondary cluster of four smaller centroids forms an elongated convex quadrilateral along the posterior-lateral flank.
